en: Psalms 74
A contemplation by Asaph.

ja: アサフによる黙想の詩。

p.src: 1  God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

ja: に拒まれたのか。 なぜあなたの
en: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
u.src: 1  God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

p.src: 2  Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

ja: の集まりを、 ご自分の相続とする
として贖われた集まりを、 あなたが
を覚えていてください。
en: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
u.src: 2  Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

p.src: 3  Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

ja: いつまでも残る廃墟へ、御
en: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
u.src: 3  Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

p.src: 4  Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

ja: 対する者たちは、あなたの
en: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
u.src: 4  Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

p.src: 5  They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

ja: のように、 木の茂みを切り開いた。
en: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
u.src: 5  They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

p.src: 6  Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

ja: で、そのすべての彫刻を
en: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
u.src: 6  Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

p.src: 7  They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

ja: を地に焼き払い、 あなたの御
en: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
u.src: 7  They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

p.src: 8  They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

ja: らを完全に打ち砕こう」と言った。 彼らは地にある、
が礼拝されるすべての場所を
en: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
u.src: 8  They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

p.src: 9  We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

ja: たちは何の奇跡のしるしも
は一人もおらず、 これがいつまで
も、私たちの間にはいない。
en: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
u.src: 9  We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

p.src: 10  How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

ja: よ、いつまで敵対する者はそしるのか。
en: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
u.src: 10  How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

p.src: 11  Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

ja: っ込められるのか。 それをふところから
ぼし尽くしてください。
en: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
u.src: 11  Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

p.src: 12  Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

en: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
u.src: 12  Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

p.src: 13  You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

en: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
u.src: 13  You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

p.src: 14  You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

ja: あなたはレビヤタンの
en: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
u.src: 14  You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

p.src: 15  You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

en: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
u.src: 15  You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

p.src: 16  The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

ja: もまたあなたのものだ。 あなたは
en: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
u.src: 16  The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

p.src: 17  You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

ja: められた。 あなたは
en: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
u.src: 17  You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

p.src: 18  Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

en: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
u.src: 18  Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

p.src: 19  Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

ja: さないでください。 あなたの
en: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
u.src: 19  Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

p.src: 20  Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

en: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
u.src: 20  Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

p.src: 21  Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

ja: が恥を受けて退くことのないようにしてください。
と乏しい者にあなたの御
を賛美させてください。
en: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
u.src: 21  Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

p.src: 22  Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

ja: 中あなたをあざけるのを
en: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
u.src: 22  Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

p.src: 23  Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

ja: れないでください。 あなたに
en: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
u.src: 23  Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
